name: Shenzhen EXC-LED Technology Co.Ltd
summary: Shenzhen EXC-LED Technology Co.Ltd engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of lighting and cloud control systems in China. The company offers intelligent control systems; landscape lighting products, including pixel, linear, wall washer, and flood light, as well as PV landscape products; cultural tourism lighting products, such as moving head lights, projection lights, washing lights, special displays, and cultural tourism landscape products. It also provides streetlights, tunnel lights, medium and high mast lights, LED modules, and IoT energy-savings lamps, solar streetlights, as well as educational lighting, including classroom, blackboard, panel, dormitory, and kindergarten lights. The company exports its products to Europe, Southeast Asia, North America, Latin America, Australia, and the Middle East. Shenzhen EXC-LED Technology Co.Ltd was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
